description: Cancel a trigger of any kind by id. Stops all future fires: a recurring schedule won't re-arm, a pending one-off won't run, an event trigger stops matching, a webhook stops accepting POSTs (401 from then on). Irreversible — recreate to re-arm (a recreated webhook gets a new URL + secret). For a webhook whose secret leaked but whose URL should keep working, rotate with sapiom_dev_agents_schedule_secret instead.
name: sapiom_dev_agents_schedule_cancel
